meta.title: How a bill held in committee can be discharged to the floor, by place and chamber
meta.status: PARTIAL: 12 of 56 places (13 with the U.S. House and Senate) have a rule read from a primary source; 26 of 110 chamber rows say a route exists and 84 are NOT FOUND (a missing source is not proof of no route); every legislature host that refused or returned errors is listed in notFound; some rows are secondary or snippet-only and say so in their note.

places.mechanism: Discharge petition (motion to discharge) signed by a majority of the whole House; filed after the measure has sat in committee 30 legislative days (7 for a Rules Committee special rule); then called up on the floor and adopted by majority vote
places.threshold: 218 signatures (majority of 435); floor adoption by simple majority
places.quote: bring to the floor for consideration a public bill or resolution that has been referred to committee but not reported
places.note: CRS R45920, updated Feb 12 2026
places.usage: 563 petitions filed 1931-2003, 47 reached the signatures, House voted discharge 26 times, 2 measures became law (CRS 97-856, https://www.everycrsreport.com/reports/97-856GOV.html); 2 petitions hit 218 in 118th Congress, 4 in 2025 (R45920)

places.mechanism: Motion to discharge a committee from a subject; must lie over one day unless unanimous consent. Separate Congressional Review Act petition of 30 senators (secondary source) for CRA disapproval resolutions only
places.threshold: Rule text read sets only a one-day layover; vote threshold NOT FOUND in the rule text. CRA petition: 30 senators (Wikipedia, secondary)
places.quote: motions to discharge a committee from the consideration of a subject ... shall lie over one day for consideration
places.note: Senate Manual, 113th Congress edition (older edition). CRA figure from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Discharge_petition

places.mechanism: Floor motion to discharge Ways and Means (7 calendar days layover); Rules and Bills in the Third Reading discharge only after 10 calendar days of reference; alternative: petition signed by a majority of members elected discharges W&M, Third Reading and Rules, effective 7 days after filing
places.threshold: Motion: majority of members present and voting. Petition: majority of members elected (81 of 160)
places.quote: may, by filing a petition signed by a majority of the members elected to the House, discharge the House committee on Ways and Means
places.note: House Rule 26 also forces joint committees to report (with a study recommendation) once reporting deadlines pass (deadline mechanism)

places.mechanism: Motion to discharge Ways and Means or Rules; Ways and Means also discharged on written petition of a majority of that committee after 45 days
places.threshold: Majority of members present and voting after 45 calendar days; two-thirds of members present and voting before 45 days
places.quote: Such motion shall require a majority vote of the members present and voting for adoption, if made after the expiration of 45 calendar days

places.mechanism: 'Pull' motion: any senator may move to place a bill on General File 20 calendar days or more after the committee hearing if the committee has not taken final action; committee action before debate begins takes precedence
places.quote: Any senator may move that a bill be placed on General File twenty calendar days or more after the committee hearing
places.note: Rule book posted as 'Current'; a senator's description (search snippet) says use is rare because it causes hard feelings with committee chairs

places.mechanism: Motion to discharge a committee; not in order until the committee has had 60 days from referral; at most one such motion per legislative day (from a search snippet of Assembly rule text)
places.quote: no such motion shall be in order, until the committee has had sixty days from the date of referral
places.note: From search summary; nysenate.gov returned 403
places.usage: Brennan Center: not a single discharge motion passed in 2006, 2007 or 2008; an April 2026 Assembly discharge motion failed 45-93 (search snippets)

places.mechanism: Motion for release from committee; 2009 rules change shortened the wait that had been 60 days
places.quote: until this change, bills had to be in committee for 60 days before a motion for release from committee was allowed
places.note: From search summary only

places.mechanism: Discharge petition: primary sponsor files motion plus petition 10 legislative days after referral; notice and fiscal note required; motion goes to calendar when petition has 61 signatures; then House votes
places.threshold: 61 signatures (majority of 120); adoption vote on the motion not stated in the rule text
places.quote: when the signatures of 61 members appear on the petition, the Principal Clerk shall place that motion on the calendar

places.mechanism: Discharge petition after 10 legislative days; also leaders (President Pro Tem, Rules chair, committee chair) may recall a bill with majority consent
places.threshold: Petition signed by two-thirds of the Senate membership (34 of 50); motion adopted by two-thirds of membership; recall by majority of members present and voting
places.quote: If the motion is adopted by two-thirds of the membership of the Senate, then the committee ... is discharged
